name: MR Christmas
summary:
Mixed Reality Christmas is aimed at younger children to introduce them to mixed reality/VR, play as one of five adorable characters, catch the presents falling from your ceiling and return them to your snow globe, how many can you collect in 90 seconds?

Place Christmas decorations around your room or on a Christmas Tree or just watch and dance along with your fave characters, whilst they have a dance in a snow themed arena, all from the comfort of your won home.
